SELECT wind_kph,
CASE 
        WHEN wind_kph < 1   THEN 0
        WHEN wind_kph < 6   THEN 1
        WHEN wind_kph < 12  THEN 2
        WHEN wind_kph < 20  THEN 3
        WHEN wind_kph < 29  THEN 4
        WHEN wind_kph < 39  THEN 5
        WHEN wind_kph < 50  THEN 6
        WHEN wind_kph < 62  THEN 7
        WHEN wind_kph < 75  THEN 8
        WHEN wind_kph < 89  THEN 9
        WHEN wind_kph < 103 THEN 10
        WHEN wind_kph < 118 THEN 11
        ELSE 12
        END AS wind,
        wind_dir as richting
FROM weather
where $__timeFilter("time") order by time desc limit 1
;

select
    min(time)::date as time,
    max(power_normal_kwh) - min(power_normal_kwh) +
    max(power_offpeak_kwh) - min(power_offpeak_kwh) as "previous year"
    from electricity
    where extract(year from time) = extract(year from now()) - 1
    group by extract(year from time), extract(month from time)
    order by 1;

select
    min(time)::date - INTERVAL '1 years' as time,
    max(power_normal_kwh) - min(power_normal_kwh) +
    max(power_offpeak_kwh) - min(power_offpeak_kwh) as "current year"
    from electricity
    where extract(year from time) = extract(year from now())
    group by extract(year from time), extract(month from time)
    order by 1;

    order by 1;

select
    (
      max(power_normal_kwh) - min(power_normal_kwh) + max(power_offpeak_kwh) - min(power_offpeak_kwh)
    ) *.21
  from
    electricity
  where
    $__timeFilter("time")

with totals as
    (select min(time)::date as day,
           (max(power_normal_kwh) - min(power_normal_kwh) +
            max(power_offpeak_kwh) - min(power_offpeak_kwh)) * 1000 as totaldaypower
    from electricity
    where $__timeFilter("time") 
    group by extract(year from time), extract(month from time), extract(day from time)
    )
  , smart as
     (select min(time)::date as day,
             name,
             sum(delta_wh) as power
      from electricity_hour_detail
      where $__timeFilter("time") and (name != 'Marantz Versterker')
      group by name, extract(year from time), extract(month from time), extract(day from time)
)

select smart.day, name, power/totaldaypower as "%"
from totals inner join smart on totals.day = smart.day
order by 1
;

select 
  to_date(concat(extract(year from time),extract(week from time)), 'iyyyiw') as week, 
  name, 
  sum(delta_wh) as " "
from electricity_hour_detail
where $__timeFilter(time) 
GROUP BY week, name
ORDER BY week, name;

SELECT
  time,
  case when isvirtual then name || '*' else name end,
  delta_wh as " "
FROM electricity_hour_detail
WHERE
  $__timeFilter("time")
ORDER BY time, name;
select time, (number_known-number_on_line) as offline, number_on_line as online from smart_plug_status where $__timeFilter(time) order by time

select 
  date_trunc('day', time) as day, 
  case when isvirtual then name || '*' else name end as name, 
  sum(delta_wh) as " "
from electricity_hour_detail
where $__timeFilter(time) 
GROUP BY day, name, isvirtual
ORDER BY day, name;

select 
  date_trunc('month', time) as month,
  name, 
  sum(delta_wh) as " "
from electricity_hour_detail
where $__timeFilter("time") 
group by month, name
ORDER by month, name

with totals as
    (select
           (max(power_normal_kwh) - min(power_normal_kwh) +
            max(power_offpeak_kwh) - min(power_offpeak_kwh)) * 1000 as totaldaypower
    from electricity
    where $__timeFilter("time") 
    )
  , smart as
     (select min(time)::date as day,
             name,
             sum(coalesce(delta_wh,0)) as power
      from electricity_hour_detail
      where $__timeFilter("time") and (name != 'Marantz Versterker')
      group by name, extract(century from time)
)

select name, power 
from smart
order by power
;

with totals as (
  select
    (
      max(power_normal_kwh) - min(power_normal_kwh) + max(power_offpeak_kwh) - min(power_offpeak_kwh)
    ) * 1000 as totaldaypower
  from
    electricity
  where
    $__timeFilter("time")
),
smart as (
  select
    min(time) :: date as day,
    name,
    sum(coalesce(delta_wh, 0)) as power
  from
    electricity_hour_detail
  where
    $__timeFilter("time")
    and (name != 'Marantz Versterker')
  group by
    name,
    extract(
      century
      from
        time
    )
)
select
  name,
  (power/1000 ) * .21 as euro
from
  smart
order by
  power;

with totals as
    (select
           (max(power_normal_kwh) - min(power_normal_kwh) +
            max(power_offpeak_kwh) - min(power_offpeak_kwh)) * 1000 as totaldaypower
    from electricity
    where $__timeFilter("time") 
    )
  , smart as
     (select min(time)::date as day,
             name,
             sum(coalesce(delta_wh,0)) as power
      from electricity_hour_detail
      where $__timeFilter("time") and (name != 'Marantz Versterker')
      group by name, extract(century from time)
)

select name, power/(select totaldaypower from totals) as "%"
from smart
order by "%"
;
